concept.zh: 已有线路与最低补网报价

brief.zh: n 个工位编号 0 到 n−1。installed 中的 [a,b] 是现有双向线路。offers 中每项 [a,b,cost] 是可增建的双向线及非负报价。让任意工位之间都能互通，返回最低新增费用，无法全连通时返回 -1。空车间和已经全连通的车间费用为 0。
brief.en: Workstations are numbered 0 through n−1. Each [a,b] in installed is an existing two-way link. Each [a,b,cost] in offers is an optional two-way link with a nonnegative price. Return the minimum new cost to connect all stations, or -1 if impossible. An empty or already connected workshop costs 0.

label.zh: 每轮采用首份可接通报价
label.en: Take the first quote joining different groups
